TOUCHDOWN: BASIC lines 530-570 read A to increase thrust by four units, up to 100, and D to decrease thrust by four units, down to zero. The program also limits thrust by available fuel. There is no start question or Enter input during flight.

In Fuse 48K at 400% speed, wait 9 seconds for TOUCHDOWN.tzx to load. Press Enter, wait 0.5 seconds, then R and Enter, and wait 1.2 seconds for the flight panel. Press A for 0.14 seconds, wait 0.35 seconds, press D for 0.14 seconds, wait 0.35 seconds, then press A for 0.14 seconds and wait 0.35 seconds. Each release includes a further 0.16-second pause. Screenshots show the live craft before and after input; random gravity and descent timing change the exact frames.
